The Drupal RESTful Web Services API is a core module that exposes Drupal entities and data as REST resources over HTTP. It supports GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE operations for entity types including nodes, users, taxonomy terms, files, and comments. Resources are accessed at uniform paths corresponding to entity type and entity ID, and support multiple serialization formats including JSON, HAL+JSON, and XML. Authentication is handled via Basic Auth, cookie-based sessions, or OAuth2. Unlike JSON:API, this module also supports custom REST resource plugins for non-entity endpoints and complex business logic operations.
